scope: R0 then R1 then short Range then gated larger repair; never I3/I7

target.coordinates: rho>=0, delta on circle, c=(bg,SF,eps) whitened by frozen prior std, latent z standard normal
target.density: pi(rho,delta,c,z|y) proportional to p0(rho|r0) * 1/(2pi) * phi3(c) * phi(z) * L_odo(c) * L_range_after_0(rho,delta,c,z)
target.joint_MH: logalpha=logpi(new)-logpi(old)+logq(old|new)-logq(new|old); if eta=log(rho), include +eta Jacobian in transformed target
target.independent_radial_only: p0 cancels only when q(rho_new)=p0 and other variables fixed
target.pCN_only: latent Gaussian prior cancels only for its reversible Gaussian-prior proposal
target.invalid_support: density zero if 1+SF<=0 or 1-eps^2/4<=0; Gaussian prior otherwise; no covariance repair

dr.tail_claim: nested domain stability only; omitted posterior tail needs independently bounded evidence before unbounded reference approval
dr.on_failure: stop dependent short Range and large experiments; preserve failure

short_range.case: explicit synthetic one-transition toy, then observed first transition R2/R4; not physical route replacement
short_range.independent_reference: independent density and randomized Sobol integration of joint rho/delta/calibration/2 latent noises
short_range.short_range_required: full joint density, first-range single use, MH reversibility tests, joint moments/CDF/mode agreement; DR PASS alone insufficient

agreement.zero_sd: INCONCLUSIVE unless both analytically fixed same quantity; never divide by zero
agreement.cdf: maximum absolute CDF difference plus 95% Monte Carlo upper error <= .05 on frozen reference quantile grid p=.01:.01:.99
agreement.joint_regions: compare masses in frozen reference 50/90/95% joint regions; abs difference plus 95% Monte Carlo upper error <= .05; no unimodal ellipse substituted for HPD
agreement.mode_masses: 12 fixed delta sectors width pi/6 starting -pi; compare each sector and disconnected density basins identified on independent toy grid; abs difference plus 95% Monte Carlo upper error <= .05
agreement.mc_error: independent replicates for integrator/SMC; autocorrelation-aware MCSE for MCMC; simultaneous CDF/region/mode errors via independent-replicate maximum statistic; if unavailable INCONCLUSIVE

large.wall_memory_limits: freeze after R1 cost measurement and before production; UNRESOLVED_CONFIG until then
